ITEM 1 | Small cube about 2.5 cm, golden-brown crust on most faces with a pale cream cut face, matte and slightly dry, sitting alone at the upper left of the plate | 8
ITEM 2 | Triangular wedge about 3.5 cm, deep golden-brown crust with darker browned edges, pale interior visible on one cut face, matte, sitting at the lower left of the plate | 15
ITEM 3 | Cluster of two or three pale cream chunks about 3 cm each, edges lightly browned, firm and slightly uneven surfaces, sitting at the top center of the plate | 12
ITEM 4 | Chunk about 3 cm, pale cream interior with a light tan edge, slightly glossy where cut, sitting to the right of the cluster | 10
ITEM 5 | Rectangular block about 4 x 2.5 cm, pale cream cut face with one side browned to a light golden crust, sitting at the center of the plate | 20
ITEM 6 | Larger block about 4 cm, golden-brown crust on the outer faces with a pale cream cut side, matte, sitting below the center block | 18
ITEM 7 | Wedge about 4 x 3 cm, deep golden-brown crust with darker caramelized patches, pale interior at the cut edge, matte, sitting at the lower right of the plate | 18
ITEM 8 | Small scattered crumbs and fragments about 0.5 to 1 cm, pale cream and light brown, dry, scattered on the right side of the plate | 2
ITEM 9 | Thin reddish-orange residue smears, faint and sparse, on the plate surface near the right and bottom edges | 2
